VisualCardPool.rationale: `=> ModelDb.CardPool<DefectCardPool>()` (Rebound.cs:18) selects the card's ART pool, not its generation pool. Presentation.

ctor.rationale: `base(1, CardType.Attack, CardRarity.Event, TargetType.AnyEnemy)` (Rebound.cs:20-23) == cost 1 / ATTACK / EVENT / ANY_ENEMY.

CanonicalVars.rationale: `new DamageVar(9m, ValueProp.Move)` (Rebound.cs:16) == `_damage = 9`, powered on both sides. The ReboundPower amount is the literal 1 in both.

OnPlay.rationale: Order matches: attack FIRST (Rebound.cs:28-30), then `PowerCmd.Apply<ReboundPower>(..., 1m, ...)` (31) == `PowerCmd.apply(..., ReboundPower, 1, applier=ctx.player)`. The order matters because ReboundPower redirects the NEXT card played, and applying it after this card's own resolution keeps Rebound itself out of scope -- true on both sides. ReboundPower is a `modify_card_play_result_pile` implementer like NostalgiaPower, so it is in card/havoc's dormant result-pile blast radius.
